title: Responsive steering, engine, and comfortable drive
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the car as responsive to steer and drive, often pairing that with comfort, while a few complaints focus on sluggish response from the automatic or overall driving feel.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise responsive steering, engine performance, and a comfortable, quiet, confidence-inspiring drive.

negative.summary: Negative reviews say the car or automatic transmission does not feel responsive enough.

limitations: One positive example says the car feels less responsive than a 3 Series, which is favorable in assignment but comparatively negative in wording, so this topic contains some ambiguity around relative responsiveness.
The sample fragments are short and focus narrowly on responsiveness and comfort, so they provide limited detail on when or why the driving feel differs.
